answer: An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The anchor schedule is applied in pulse and karst reveals each instalment. A payout is split so that 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2494 identities would post 3091 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
